an9.10:1.1: bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an9.10:1.3: arahā arahattāya paṭipanno anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno gotrabhū.
an9.10:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave nava puggalā āhuneyyā …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
